result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best overall starting point. It's relatively easy to use, has a generous free option, and gives you room to grow without immediately needing a complicated system.

However, the best CRM depends on how your team manages customers and sales.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot**

(Best overall)

- Easy to learn and implement
- Contact and deal management
- Email tracking and sales pipeline
- Free plan available for up to 2 users

Best for: Small businesses wanting sales, marketing and customer management together.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive | Marketplace Red Cactus](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IRFkfHYVKMpS2NXrRHE5xQL0_0qOqMxZ9tZ7IGfuLgaAd6FUoWTIN74_tGZqEXqWBstcAfVvix5tSwWCh_Z9jpsxIf_mFz50_GOJKyrc87_-7A9-hZKPxIv5_eq3RLE179FfxUm2MozwClA0LFh60tHrn4H8CNx2XDlT_R6fcmbJlEDJEuSbC8bnWGykfEEG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Tracks deals and follow-ups
- Easy to see what everyone is working on
- Paid plans start around \$14/user/month (USD, annual billing)

Best for: Teams actively selling products or services.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

- Lots of customization
- Sales automation and reporting
- Integrates with other Zoho business tools
- Free plan for up to 3 users

Best for: Budget-conscious businesses that want flexibility.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone, email and chat capabilities
- Lead scoring and sales automation
- Affordable entry-level paid plan

Best for: Teams that communicate with lots of prospects.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products | Boost Productivity Today — Elevate Operations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9pbfxtp9MRSzmGqOOXUT3zYq1fPIuocDylKAQoIzVyuW1Vjc44XoGiROM2GBYduUngwZNPfMFXzqdnmJ1poftmoV-bK85Cp0YYpYmV5sjFjpnjYHjyVWJd9MpDQXQDk0zHwEfS7B57VsWkUtP1cpZQ-ZPXVz1YthngyreHroaIgVKVfnbNj-IFVycI5aW_GQ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Very visual interface
- Customizable workflows
- Combines sales tracking with team collaboration

Best for: Teams managing sales alongside projects and operations.
